tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /ka kha'i 'phreng ba dang sbyar ba'i bya dka'i sgra rgyan zung ldan blo gsal yid 'phrog ces bya ba bzhugs/

na mo mañdzu gho ṣa ya/ ma lus lus can 'gro la rjes brtse brtse bas dam pa'i chos tshul tshul bzhin ston mdzad bla ma dang*/ /chos kun kun nas ji bzhin legs mkhyen mkhyen brtse spangs rtogs yongs rdzogs rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das/ /bden gnyis gnyis med sdug kun nyer zhi zhi ba nyes pa'i skyon bral bral ba lam bden dam pa'i chos/ /legs tshogs tshogs gnyis nyams su len mdzad mdzad mchog gzhan las khyad 'phags 'phags pa'i dge 'dun bcas la 'dud/ /ka ma la dang bsil zer can steng gsal gsal mtshan dpe'i dpal 'bar 'bar ba'i 'od kyi dra ba can/ kha dog gtso ma'i gser gyi mdog ltar lhang lhang ches gsal rab brjid brjid chags gser gyi lhun po bzhin/ /ga na 'dug ste bsgrims cing 'bad pas yang yang bltas kyang yid kun kun nas 'phrog byed dad gus g.yo/ /nga sogs thar 'dod gdul bya'i tshogs la zab zab dam pa'i chos ston ston pa shākya'i gtso der 'dud/ /ca co bral ba'i legs bshad bzang bzang 'gro mang don du du ma'i thabs gyis ston mdzad cing*/ /cha lugs logs sprul ma nges 'dzum 'dzum mchu sgros rab dmar dmar ba'i bim pa gzhon nu bzhin/ /ja sogasabaza' btung bor nas yang yang khyod nyid rtag dran dran nas gsol ba 'debs byed na/ /nya rgyas zla 'dra'i zhal dkyil myur myur ston la thugs rjes rjes su zungs shig mi pham mgon/ /ta thā ga ta'i 'khor tshogs mang mang dbus na ches zab zab mo stong nyid smra ba la/ /tha ma'i dus 'dir rgyal bas nges nges gzhan las lhag cing kun mkhyen mkhyen rab dbang phyug ces bsngags shing*/ /da ltar 'jam pa'i dbyangs zhes phyogs phyogs kun la rab grags grags pas sa steng khyab pa de/ /na rga 'chi la thug kyang gus gus mi gtong rab mchod mchod sprin rgya mtshos mnyes par bya/ /ba ra mi ta'i spyod tshul dka' dka' kun kyang legs mdzad mdzad mchog kun nas phul byung zhing*/

/pha rol rigs drug 'gro la yang yang nyin dang mtshan du du ma'i spyan gyis legs gzigs te/ /ba spu'i grangs kyi sprul ba mang mang spros nas don sgrub sgrub tshul khyad par bsam mi khyab/ /ma yis bu gcig lta bur gces gces dgongs nas thugs brtse brtse bas gzigs mdzad spyan ras gzigs/ /tsa la mi mnga'i sku mchog gtum gtum khros pa ji bzhin bzhin ni rnam par 'gyur ba can/ /tsha zer rgyas pa'i gdan la 'gying 'gying tshul bzhugs ma lus lus med sde brgyad tshogs kyi rje/ /dza ya stong gi bstan pa thams cad nges nges khyod kyis legs srung srung bar zhal bzhes sa gsum gyi/ /wa skyes lta bu'i gdon bgegs ngan ngan thal bar rlog byed byed po gsang bdag rdo rje 'dzin/ /zha yig lta bur sgor mor 'khyil 'khyil zla gdan steng na na chung gzhon nu'i 'jo sgeg can/ /za byed srid gsum bdag mo mdzes mdzes lha mo'i skur sprul sprul ba'i gar gyi rnam rol ba/ /'a cag 'dod ldan yid dbang brtan brtan dag 'phrog rab snyan snyan pa'i rgyud mangs spreng ba'i tshe/ /ya mtshan che ba'i sgra snyan gang gang srid pa de kun kun nas sgrog mdzad tshangs sras ma/ /ra ri'i dri bral gang sku ldem ldem g.yu yi ljon bzhin bzhin 'dzum sgeg pa'i nyams ldan cing*/ /la las mthong na sngon med dga' dga'i dpal ster ci 'dod 'dod rgu 'byung ba'i nor bu bzhin/ /sha rus gting nas g.yos pa'i gus gus nges par skye 'gyur 'gyur med dad pa brtan po yis/ /sa gsum 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal myong myong zhi mdzad rgyal yum yum mchog sgrol ma rtag tu mchod/ /ha cang gdung ba'i dbyangs gyis lhang lhang gsal bar bstod tshe tshe dang bsod nams dpal steng zhing*/ /a tsa la yi dad pas yang yang gus mchod gzungs ring ring du dad cing brjod pa'i tshe/ /tshe yi rig 'dzin dngos grub 'dod 'dod myur stsol sdig kun kun nas sbyong mdzad bcom ldan

ma/ /ma gcig rnam rgyal zhabs pad dung dung yid kyis bsten na na rga 'chi las sgrol bar mdzod/ /gang gis gang btab smon 'grub bzang bzang rnam dag zhing mchog mchog tu legs grub 'od dpag med/ /snyigs dus snyigs ma'i 'gro ba mang mang dag la rab brtse brtse bas dgongs mdzad sman gyi bla/ /las ngan las sgrib ma lus nges nges kun nas sbyong mdzad mdzad pa phul byung mi 'khrugs pa/ /rnam gsum rnam pa kun du myur myur byon la thugs rjes rjes su bzung nas byin gyis rlobs/ /yang gcig deng dus sngags chog shes pa'i/ /blo ldan mang du 'byung yang srid kyi/ /a don skye med rtogs pa'i mkhas pa/ /ha cang de tsam 'byung ba ma yin/ /sa steng gzhan la gnod 'tshe che zhing*/ /sha khrag chang la rngams pa'i mi ngan/ /la la shi tshe dmyal ba yi dwags/ /ra lug phag sogs dud 'gror 'gyur nges/ /ya yo med pa'i dad pa brtan ldan/ /'a cag dkon mchog rtag tu mchod cing*/ /za byed gshin rje gshed sogs yi dam/ /zhwa ltar spyi bos rgyun du bsten rigs/ /wā gi shā ri'i sgom bzlas mdzad na/ /dza ya'i dgongs zab shes nas de don/ /tsha grang sdug bsngal dang blangs sgom na/ /tsa go ra ltar nags su gnas legs/ /ma sogs sems can kun don byed na/ /ba mo'i mdog ltar dkar ba'i sems kyis/ /pha rol gzhan las 'tshe ba spaung la/ /pa ra mi ta'i spyod tshul sgrubs shig /na rga 'chi ba nges par 'ong bas/ /da lta chos zhig ma bsgrubs bsdad na/ /tha chad ma rabs nyid du 'gyur phyir/ /ta thā ga tas smod pa'i gnas so/ /nya ltar dgon grong phyogs gzhan dag la/ /ja chang zhim po btung ba'i ched du/ /cha lugs mdzes mdzes tsam zhig byas nas/ /ca co don med brjod bzhin ma rgyugs/ /nga rgyal ma byed shes bya rgya che/ /ga na 'dug kyang rang sems la blta/ /kha ton dge sbyor rnam pa mang dang*/ /ka dag stong nyid zab mo sgoms shig /ka kha'i phreng ldan sgra rgyan 'di dag

/nyams mtshar ched du bshad sgrub ces byas/ /legs par sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni/ /gnas brtan bkra shis ming can nyid do/ /maṅga laṃ// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ co ne grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung 'bum/ka kha'i 'phreng ba dang sbyar ba'i bya dka'i sgra rgyan zung ldan blo gsal yid 'phrog ces bya ba bzhugs/ -PAGE 74--PAGE 73--PAGE 71-
